reassurance.title: First: this isn't you failing.
reassurance.text: Babies cry and toddlers tantrum. Every parent has been there, and most people are kinder than the stares suggest. You don't have to fix it fast.

steps.title: Find a quieter spot
steps.text: Move somewhere calmer: a corner, a corridor, outside. Less noise and light helps.

steps.title: Steady yourself first: one slow breath
steps.text: One slow breath first. Your calm helps them settle. If it all feels too much, it's OK to put your baby down somewhere safe for a few minutes. Never shake a baby.

steps.title: Hold them close
steps.text: Hold them close and say softly: “I've got you.” Keep words to a minimum.

steps.title: Gently distract (6 months+)
steps.text: Once the worst has passed, offer something new: a dog to spot, a song, a snack.

steps.title: Adjust the plan
steps.text: Hungry? Tired? Too much going on? Adjust the rest of the day. Dropping one plan is fine.

kit.title: Keep these in your bag
items: White noise app on your phone
A downloaded show or music playlist
